title: Towards Understanding Deep Learning Model in Image Recognition via Coverage Test
abstract: arXiv:2505.08814v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) play a crucial role in the field of artificial intelligence, and their security-related testing has been a prominent research focus. By inputting test cases, the behavior of models is examined for anomalies, and coverage metrics are utilized to determine the extent of neurons covered by these test cases. With the widespread application and advancement of DNNs, different types of neural behaviors have garnered attention, leading to the emergence of various coverage metrics for neural networks. translated_title: 基于覆盖测试的图像识别深度学习模型理解研究
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络（DNNs）在人工智能领域扮演着至关重要的角色，其与安全性相关的测试一直是突出的研究焦点。通过输入测试用例，可以检验模型行为是否存在异常，并利用覆盖率指标来确定这些测试用例所覆盖神经元的范围。随着DNN的广泛应用与发展，不同类型的神经行为受到关注，由此催生了多种神经网络覆盖率指标。然而，目前针对这些覆盖率指标缺乏实证研究，特别是缺乏对模型深度、配置信息与神经网络覆盖率之间关系和规律的分析。本文旨在研究四种覆盖率指标的关系与规律：主要功能覆盖、边界覆盖、层次覆盖和结构覆盖。为此进行了一系列实证实验……
tldr: 本文通过实证实验系统研究了图像识别深度学习模型中四种神经网络覆盖率指标（主要功能覆盖、边界覆盖、层次覆盖和结构覆盖）与模型深度及配置信息之间的关系与规律。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a series of empirical experiments to investigate the relationships and patterns between four neural network coverage metrics—primary functionality, boundary, hierarchy, and structural coverage—and model depth and configuration information in deep learning models for image recognition.
